Cast commune with nature as a ritual; the answer arrives as a spirit beast.

While raging: Bear gives each hostile creature within 5 feet of you disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you or another with this feature; Eagle gives you a flying speed equal to your walking speed, though you fall if you end your turn in the air with nothing holding you up; Elk lets you pass through a Large or smaller creature's space as a bonus action, and it is knocked prone and takes 1d12 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage unless it succeeds on a Strength save (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier); Tiger lets you make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action after moving at least 20 feet straight toward a Large or smaller target; Wolf lets you knock a Large or smaller creature prone as a bonus action when you hit it with a melee weapon attack.
Ancestral spirits answer this barbarian's rage and shield the people fighting beside them.

While raging, the first creature you hit on each of your turns has disadvantage on attack rolls against anyone but you until the start of your next turn or until your rage ends, and when it hits a creature other than you, that creature has resistance to the attack's damage.
While raging, a reaction reduces damage to an ally you can see within 30 feet by 2d6, rising to 3d6 at 10th level and 4d6 at 14th.
Cast augury or clairvoyance once per short or long rest, using Wisdom, without a slot or components.
Damage prevented by Spirit Shield is dealt straight back to the attacker as force damage.
Rage manifests as a 10-foot aura of desert heat, arctic cold, or sea storm.

Choose an environment (desert, sea or tundra), changed when you gain a barbarian level. When you enter your rage its 10-foot aura wakes, and on each later turn of the rage a bonus action wakes it again. Desert: each other creature in it takes 2 fire damage (3 at 5th level, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th). Sea: one creature of your choice in it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 lightning damage, half on a success (2d6 at 10th, 3d6 at 15th, 4d6 at 20th). Tundra: each creature of your choice in it gains 2 temporary hit points (rising with the desert's numbers). Its save DC is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.

A lasting boon of your environment. Desert: you resist fire damage, shrug off extreme heat, and can set an unattended flammable object alight with a touch as an action. Sea: you resist lightning damage, breathe underwater and gain a 30-foot swimming speed. Tundra: you resist cold damage, shrug off extreme cold, and can freeze a 5-foot cube of water with a touch as an action.
Every ally inside your Storm Aura shares your Storm Soul damage resistance.

Your aura's environment sharpens. Desert: right after a creature in the aura hits you, a reaction makes it save on Dexterity or take fire damage equal to half your barbarian level. Sea: when you hit a creature in the aura, a reaction makes it save on Strength or be knocked prone. Tundra: whenever the aura's effect activates, one creature you can see in it saves on Strength or has its speed reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn.
A divine champion whose fury is holy, and who death itself has trouble keeping.
The first creature you hit each turn while raging takes an extra 1d6 + half your barbarian level radiant or necrotic damage.
A spell that restores you to life needs no material component.
Once per rage, reroll a failed saving throw and use the new result.
A bonus action, once per long rest, grants up to ten allies within 60 feet advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn.

While you rage, having 0 hit points doesn't knock you unconscious. You still make death saving throws and suffer the usual effects of taking damage at 0 hit points, but if you would die from failed death saves you don't die until your rage ends, and then only if you still have 0 hit points.
Rage grows weapons out of the barbarian's own body: claws, a tail, savage teeth.

When you enter your rage, grow one natural weapon until it ends, a melee weapon that uses Strength: Bite (1d8 piercing; once on each of your turns, a bite that hits while you have less than half your hit points restores hit points equal to your proficiency bonus), Claws (1d6 slashing, one in each hand; once on each of your turns, attacking with a claw in the Attack action lets you make one more claw attack) or Tail (1d8 piercing with a 10-foot reach; when a creature you can see within 10 feet hits you, a reaction adds 1d8 to your AC against that attack).
Your natural weapons count as magical, and you can adapt to swim, climb or jump after each rest.
A proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest, a natural-weapon hit forces a Wisdom save: the target either attacks a creature of your choice or takes 2d12 psychic damage.

When you enter your rage, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest, you can choose a number of other willing creatures you can see within 30 feet equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum one). You gain 5 temporary hit points for each that accepts, and until the rage ends each of them can, once on each of its turns, roll a d6 and add it to the damage of an attack that hits.
Raw magic leaks out of this barbarian every time their temper does.
As an action, sense spells and magic items within 60 feet, a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.

When you enter your rage, roll a d8 for a magical effect that lasts the rage (save DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier): 1, shadowy tendrils deal 1d12 necrotic damage to each creature of your choice within 30 feet that fails a Constitution save and give you 1d12 temporary hit points; 2, you teleport up to 30 feet, and again as a bonus action on later turns; 3, a spirit appears beside a creature within 30 feet and bursts at the end of the turn, dealing 1d6 force damage to each creature within 5 feet of it that fails a Dexterity save, and again as a bonus action on later turns; 4, a weapon you hold deals force damage and gains light and thrown (20/60), returning to your hand; 5, each creature that hits you with an attack roll takes 1d6 force damage; 6, you and your allies within 10 feet of you gain +1 AC; 7, the ground within 15 feet of you is difficult terrain for your enemies; 8, a bolt of light deals 1d6 radiant damage to a creature within 30 feet and blinds it until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on a Constitution save, and again as a bonus action on later turns.

A proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest, touch a creature and choose: for 10 minutes it adds a d3 to its attack rolls and ability checks, or it rolls a d3 and regains one expended spell slot of that level or lower (a creature can take the slot only once per long rest).
When you take damage or fail a save while raging, a reaction rerolls your Wild Surge effect.
Whenever you roll on the wild magic table, roll twice and choose either effect; if both dice show the same number, choose any effect on the table.
A barbarian who channels giantkind, growing to their size and hurling what comes to hand.
You learn to speak, read and write Giant, or another language if you already know it, and you learn your choice of the druidcraft or thaumaturgy cantrip, cast with Wisdom.

While raging you gain Crushing Throw (a thrown weapon attack that hits using Strength adds your Rage damage bonus) and Giant Stature (your reach grows by 5 feet, and if you are smaller than Large you become Large, with what you carry, if there is room).

When you enter your rage, infuse one weapon you hold with acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder until the rage ends: its damage becomes that type, it deals an extra 1d6 damage of it, and it gains the thrown property (20/60), returning to your hand after a throw. Its benefits do not work for anyone else, and a bonus action changes the element.

As a bonus action while raging, choose a Medium or smaller creature within your reach and move it to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of you; an unwilling creature avoids this with a Strength save (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier). A creature left in the air falls and lands prone.

When you rage, your reach grows by 10 feet, you can become Large or Huge (your choice) if there is room, Mighty Impel can move Large or smaller creatures, and Elemental Cleaver's extra damage becomes 2d6.
A battle-skald who fights in the front rank and turns the fight itself into the song.
Proficiency with medium armor, shields and martial weapons.
A creature holding your Bardic Inspiration die may add it to a damage roll, or use a reaction to add it to AC against one attack.
Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
After casting a spell with an action, a bonus action makes one weapon attack.
Feywild-touched charm: this bard rescues allies with a word and commands rooms on presence alone.

As a bonus action, spend one Bardic Inspiration: a number of creatures you can see within 60 feet equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum one) each gain 5 temporary hit points (8 at 5th level, 11 at 10th, 14 at 15th) and can use a reaction to move up to their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

After performing for at least a minute, choose a number of humanoids within 60 feet who watched and listened to all of it equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum one); each makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or is charmed by you for an hour, idolizing you and hindering anyone who opposes you. Once per short or long rest.

As a bonus action you cast command without a spell slot and take on an unearthly majesty for a minute (concentration). On each of your turns while it lasts you can cast command again as a bonus action without a slot, and a creature charmed by you automatically fails its save against it. Once per long rest.
A bonus action makes you awesome to behold for a minute: an attacker must pass a Charisma save or lose the attack and be unable to target you that turn.
A blade-dancing performer whose weapon flourishes are the performance.
Proficiency with medium armor and the scimitar; your weapon can serve as a spellcasting focus.
Choose the Dueling or Two-Weapon Fighting style.
Your speed rises by 10 feet on any turn you take the Attack action, and once per turn you may spend a Bardic Inspiration die on a Defensive, Slashing or Mobile flourish.
Attack twice when you take the Attack action.
Roll a d6 for a flourish instead of spending a Bardic Inspiration die.
A bard who trades in fear and secrets and wears other people's lives like costumes.
Spend a Bardic Inspiration die on a weapon hit for extra psychic damage, 2d6 at 3rd level and rising with bard level.
A minute of private conversation frightens a humanoid of you or someone you name for an hour on a failed Wisdom save; once per short or long rest.
A reaction captures the shadow of a humanoid that just died, letting you wear their identity for an hour; once per short or long rest.
Whisper a creature's darkest secret: on a failed Wisdom save it is charmed and obeys your requests for 8 hours; once per long rest.
A rhetorician who never misses with a word and never wastes an inspiration die.
Treat any d20 of 9 or lower as a 10 on Persuasion and Deception checks.
A bonus action spends a Bardic Inspiration die to subtract it from one creature's next saving throw.
An inspiration die that fails to change the outcome is not spent.

As an action, choose a number of creatures within 60 feet equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum one): for an hour they understand you, whatever language you speak. Once per long rest, or by expending a spell slot.
A reaction copies a successful inspiration die onto another creature, a Charisma-modifier number of times per long rest.
The Song of Creation still echoes, and this bard can sing objects and dancing things into being.

Whenever you give a creature a Bardic Inspiration die, a mote orbits it, and when it spends the die the mote adds: on an ability check, it rolls the die twice and uses either roll; on an attack roll, the mote bursts and each creature of your choice within 5 feet of the target makes a Constitution save against your spell save DC or takes thunder damage equal to the die's roll; on a saving throw, it gains temporary hit points equal to the die's roll + your Charisma modifier (minimum 1).

As an action, animate a Large or smaller nonmagical item within 30 feet as a Dancing Item for an hour. It acts on your initiative right after you, takes the Dodge action unless you command it with a bonus action, has AC 16 and 10 + five times your bard level hit points, attacks with Force-Empowered Slam (your spell attack modifier, reach 5 feet, 1d10 + your proficiency bonus force damage), and its Irrepressible Dance raises or lowers by 10 feet the speed of a creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of it. Once per long rest, or by expending a spell slot of 3rd level or higher.

When you use Performance of Creation you can make a number of items equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum two): one may be the largest size the feature allows and the rest must be Small or Tiny, and no item is limited by gold value.
A medium who calls up stories from the dead and lets the tale decide what happens next.
You know guidance and can cast it at 60 feet.
A candle, a deck, a talking board or the like serves as your spellcasting focus and adds a die to the damage or healing of your bard spells at higher levels.
Spend a Bardic Inspiration die and roll on a table of spirit tales, each with its own effect you can release on a target.

During a short or long rest you hold an hour-long ritual with up to your proficiency bonus in willing creatures (you included). At its end you learn one divination or necromancy spell from any class's list, of a level you can cast and no higher than the number of creatures who took part; it counts as a bard spell, doesn't count against your spells known, and stays until you start a long rest. Once per long rest.
When you roll on the Spirit Tales table, roll the die twice and choose which effect to bestow; if both dice show the same number, pick any effect on the table.
A cleric of the gods of learning, for whom every secret is a form of power.
Two extra languages, and proficiency plus expertise in two of Arcana, History, Nature and Religion.
Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
Gain proficiency with one skill or tool of your choice for 10 minutes.
Read a creature's surface thoughts for a minute and cast suggestion on it without a slot.
Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips.

You spend at least a minute in meditation, concentrating as on a spell, for up to a number of minutes equal to your Wisdom score. Holding an object, you see its previous owner, how they gained and lost it and the latest significant event involving them, and each further minute reaches one owner earlier, as far back as your Wisdom score in days. Or you see significant events of the past in your surroundings (up to a 50-foot cube), one per minute, going back that many days. Once per short or long rest.
A cleric of sun and flame who burns away darkness and the things that hide in it.
A reaction imposes disadvantage on an attack against you, a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.
Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
Dispel magical darkness within 30 feet and deal 2d10 + cleric level radiant damage to hostile creatures, halved on a Constitution save.
Warding Flare can also protect a creature other than you that you can see within 30 feet when it is attacked.
Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips.
For a minute, shed 60 feet of bright light and give enemies in it disadvantage on saves against fire and radiant spells.
A priest of the wild gods, as at home with beasts and weather as with prayer.
One druid cantrip and proficiency in Animal Handling, Nature or Survival.
Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
Beasts and plants within 30 feet that fail a Wisdom save are charmed for a minute and friendly to you and your allies.
A reaction grants you or an ally within 30 feet resistance to one instance of acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage.
Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 cold, fire or lightning damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.
A bonus action commands creatures charmed by your Channel Divinity.
Thunder and lightning made doctrine: this cleric answers insult with a storm.
Proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.
A reaction deals 2d8 lightning or thunder damage to a creature that hits you in melee, halved on a Dexterity save; a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.
Deal maximum damage instead of rolling for lightning or thunder damage.
Lightning damage you deal pushes a Large or smaller creature 10 feet away.
Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 thunder damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.
You have a flying speed equal to your walking speed while not underground or indoors.
A holy trickster whose blessings are disguises, duplicates and well-aimed mischief.
Touch a willing creature to give it advantage on Stealth checks for an hour.
Become invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack or cast.
Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 poison damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.
Invoke Duplicity creates up to four illusory duplicates.
A battle priest whose god expects the front line, not the back rank.
Proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.
A bonus-action weapon attack when you take the Attack action, a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.
When you make an attack roll, spend Channel Divinity for a +10 bonus to it, after seeing the roll but before the GM says whether it hits.
A reaction grants an ally within 30 feet +10 on an attack roll.
Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's type, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.
Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
A cleric of the gods of endings, comfortable with necrotic power and the grave's authority.
Learn a necromancy cantrip; single-target necromancy cantrips can hit a second creature within 5 feet of the first.
A melee hit deals extra necrotic damage equal to 5 + twice your cleric level.
Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 necrotic damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.

When you cast a necromancy spell of 1st through 5th level that targets only one creature, it can target two creatures within 5 feet of each other; if the spell consumes its material components, you provide them for each target.
A smith-priest who blesses armor and weapons and treats the anvil as an altar.
Proficiency with heavy armor and smith's tools.
After a long rest, enchant a weapon or suit of armor you touch with a +1 bonus until you use the feature again.
An hour of ritual smithing creates a simple metal item worth up to 100 gp.
+1 AC while wearing heavy armor, and resistance to fire damage.
Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 fire damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.
Immunity to fire damage, and resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing while in heavy armor.
A warden of the border between life and death who hates undeath more than dying.
Healing spells cast on a creature at 0 hit points heal the maximum; you can cast spare the dying at 30 feet as a bonus action.
Detect undead within 60 feet as an action, a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.
Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave

As an action, spend Channel Divinity to curse a creature within 30 feet until the end of your next turn: the next time you or an ally hits it with an attack, it has vulnerability to all of that attack's damage, and the curse ends.
A reaction turns a critical hit against a creature within 30 feet into a normal hit, a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.
Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips.

When an enemy you can see dies within 60 feet of you, you or one creature of your choice within 60 feet regains hit points equal to the enemy's number of Hit Dice. You can't use it while incapacitated, and once you do, not again until the start of your next turn.
A cleric of law and hierarchy who turns obedience into a battlefield asset.
Heavy armor, plus proficiency in Intimidation or Persuasion.
After a spell of 1st level or higher targets an ally, that ally may use a reaction to make one weapon attack.

As an action, spend Channel Divinity: each creature of your choice within 30 feet that can see or hear you makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you until the end of your next turn or until it takes damage, and you can make any of them drop what they are holding.
A Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest, cast an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher as a bonus action.
Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 psychic damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.
Once per turn, a creature you damage with Divine Strike takes an extra 2d8 psychic damage the next time an ally hits it.
A binder of bonds whose blessing makes a party fight and endure as one thing.
Proficiency in Performance, Insight or Persuasion.

As an action, choose a number of willing creatures within 30 feet equal to your proficiency bonus (you can be one): for 10 minutes, or until you use it again, a bonded creature within 30 feet of another can add a d4 to an attack roll, ability check or saving throw it makes, once per turn. A proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Move without provoking and heal each creature you pass within 5 feet for 2d6 + your Wisdom modifier.

When a creature bonded by your Emboldening Bond is about to take damage, another bonded creature within 30 feet of it can use a reaction to teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it and take all of that damage instead.
Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips.
Emboldening Bond and Protective Bond now work across 60 feet, and a creature that takes damage for another through Protective Bond has resistance to it.
A shepherd of the border hour, granting sight in the dark and calm against terror.
Darkvision out to 300 feet, shareable with a Wisdom-modifier number of creatures once per long rest.
Touch a creature to give it advantage on its next initiative roll.
A 30-foot aura for a minute that grants each ally either temporary hit points of 1d6 + cleric level or an end to a charm or fear effect, each round.
A bonus action in dim light or darkness grants flight for a minute, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Once per turn a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.
Allies inside Twilight Sanctuary have half cover.
A cleric of the gods of magic itself, as much a scholar of spellcraft as a priest.
Proficiency in Arcana and two wizard cantrips of your choice.

As an action, spend Channel Divinity: one celestial, elemental, fey or fiend within 30 feet that can see or hear you makes a Wisdom save or is turned for a minute or until it takes damage. From 5th level, a creature that fails, isn't on its plane of origin and has a challenge rating at or below a limit (1/2 at 5th level, 1 at 8th, 2 at 11th, 3 at 14th, 4 at 17th) is banished for a minute instead, as the banishment spell without concentration.
Restoring hit points with a spell also ends one spell of equal or lower level on the target.
Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips.
Choose one wizard spell each of 6th, 7th, 8th and 9th level; each becomes one of your domain spells, always prepared and counted as a cleric spell for you.
A druid who fights as a beast, shifting fast and into far more dangerous shapes than most.
Wild Shape as a bonus action, and while transformed spend a spell slot as a bonus action to heal 1d8 per slot level.
Wild Shape into beasts of challenge rating 1 at 2nd level, and up to a third of your druid level rounded down from 6th level on.
Your beast form's attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance.
Spend two Wild Shape uses at once to become an air, earth, fire or water elemental.
A druid tied to the Summer Court, offering rest, safe camps and moonlit escape routes.

You have a pool of d6s equal to your druid level, refilled on a long rest. As a bonus action, spend up to half your druid level of them to heal a creature you can see within 120 feet by the total rolled; it also gains 1 temporary hit point per die spent.

During a short or long rest you can touch a point to raise an invisible 30-foot-radius sphere around it until the rest ends or you leave it, blocked by total cover. Inside, you and your allies gain +5 to Dexterity (Stealth) and Wisdom (Perception) checks, and light from open flames inside can't be seen from outside.

As a bonus action you teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, or as an action you teleport a willing creature you touch up to 30 feet; a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once) per long rest.

When you finish a short rest you can cast dream (as the messenger), scrying or teleportation circle without a spell slot or material components; the circle opens to the last place you finished a long rest on this plane, and fails without being spent if there is none. Once per long rest.
A speaker for the spirits of beasts and fey who summons help and keeps it alive.
You learn Sylvan and can speak with beasts.

As a bonus action, call a spirit to a point within 60 feet for a minute (once per short or long rest), with a 30-foot aura you can move 60 feet as a bonus action. Bear: each creature of your choice in the aura when it appears gains 5 + your druid level temporary hit points, and you and your allies have advantage on Strength checks and saves in it. Hawk: when a creature makes an attack roll against a target in the aura, a reaction gives it advantage, and you and your allies have advantage on Perception checks in it. Unicorn: you and your allies have advantage on checks to detect creatures in the aura, and when you cast a spell with a slot that restores hit points, each creature of your choice in the aura regains hit points equal to your druid level.
Beasts and fey you conjure or create with a spell gain 2 extra hit points per Hit Die, and their natural weapons are magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.
Summoned creatures inside your Spirit Totem aura heal half your druid level at the end of your turns.

When you are reduced to 0 hit points or incapacitated against your will, you gain the effects of conjure animals cast with a 9th-level slot: four beasts of your choice, each challenge rating 2 or lower, appear within 20 feet, protect you and attack your foes for an hour without concentration, or until you dismiss them. Once per long rest.
A druid of decay who sees rot as part of the cycle and wears a halo of necrotic spores.

When a creature you can see moves into a space within 10 feet of you or starts its turn there, a reaction deals it 1d4 necrotic damage unless it succeeds on a Constitution save against your spell save DC (1d6 at 6th level, 1d8 at 10th, 1d10 at 14th).
Spend a Wild Shape use to gain four temporary hit points per druid level and add 1d6 necrotic to melee weapon hits for 10 minutes.
A reaction reanimates a beast or humanoid that dies within 10 feet as a zombie under your command for an hour, a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.

While Symbiotic Entity is active, a bonus action hurls spores into a 10-foot cube within 30 feet for a minute, until you use it again or until the entity ends. A creature that moves into the cube or starts its turn there makes a Constitution save against your spell save DC or takes your Halo of Spores damage, at most once per turn, and you can't use Halo of Spores' reaction while the cube lasts.
Immunity to blindness, deafness, fear and poison, and critical hits against you count as normal hits.
A druid who reads the constellations and takes their shapes: archer, chalice and dragon.
A charted map serving as your spellcasting focus; you know guidance and can cast guiding bolt a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest without a slot.

Spend a Wild Shape use to glow with a constellation for 10 minutes: Archer gives a bonus-action ranged attack for 1d8 + Wisdom radiant damage, Chalice heals a second creature whenever you cast a healing spell, Dragon lets you treat a d20 of 9 or lower as a 10 on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and concentration saves.
After a long rest, read your map for Weal or Woe; a reaction then adds or subtracts a d6 on a roll near you, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Starry Form improves: Archer and Chalice roll 2d8, Dragon grants a 20-foot fly speed, and you may change constellation each turn.
While in Starry Form you are partly incorporeal and resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
A druid bonded to a wildfire spirit, holding to the truth that fire clears ground for new growth.
Spend a Wild Shape use to summon a wildfire spirit companion that acts on your turn, with a fiery teleport that damages creatures around its arrival.
While the spirit is out, your fire and healing spells gain 1d8, and you may cast them from the spirit's position.

When a Small or larger creature dies within 30 feet of you or your wildfire spirit, a spectral flame burns in its space for a minute. When a creature you can see enters that space, a reaction puts the flame out to restore 2d10 + your Wisdom modifier hit points to it or deal it that much fire damage; a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Once per long rest, dropping to 0 hit points destroys the spirit and returns you to half your hit point maximum instead.
A student of martial technique who spends superiority dice on precise, tide-turning maneuvers.
Four superiority dice of d8 (five at 7th level, six at 15th), regained on a short or long rest, spent on maneuvers whose save DC is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Dexterity modifier.
Three maneuvers known, such as Trip Attack, Disarming Attack, Riposte, Precision Attack, Menacing Attack and Commander's Strike, rising to five known at 7th level, seven at 10th and nine at 15th.
Proficiency with one kind of artisan's tools.
A minute of observation reveals whether a creature beats you in two chosen traits such as Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, AC, current hit points, class levels or fighter levels.
Your superiority dice become d10s, and d12s at 18th level.
When you roll initiative with no superiority dice left, you regain one.
A fighter who braids wizard magic into swordplay, casting and striking in the same breath.
Third-caster wizard spellcasting keyed to Intelligence, drawn mostly from abjuration and evocation.
Bond up to two weapons in an hour-long ritual: you cannot be disarmed of them and can summon one to your hand as a bonus action.
After casting a cantrip with your action, a bonus action makes one weapon attack.
A weapon hit gives that creature disadvantage on its next save against a spell of yours before the end of your next turn.
Action Surge also teleports you up to 30 feet.
War Magic works after casting any spell, not only a cantrip.
An elf-trained bowman who puts a spell on the arrow instead of in the air.
The prestidigitation or druidcraft cantrip, and proficiency in Arcana or Nature.

Once per turn when you fire an arrow from a shortbow or longbow as part of the Attack action, you can apply one Arcane Shot option you know, deciding when the arrow hits unless the option makes no attack roll. You know two options (Banishing, Beguiling, Bursting, Enfeebling, Grasping, Piercing, Seeking, Shadow) and learn another at 7th, 10th, 15th and 18th level; you have two uses, regained on a short or long rest, and the save DC is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier. Beguiling, Bursting, Enfeebling, Grasping and Shadow deal 2d6 damage, Piercing and Seeking 1d6 and Banishing none; at 18th level these become 4d6, 2d6 and 2d6 force.
Arrows you fire from a shortbow or longbow count as magical.
A bonus action rerolls a missed magic-arrow attack against a different target within 60 feet.
When you roll initiative with no Arcane Shot uses left, you regain one.
A mounted champion and battlefield anchor who makes enemies regret walking past.
Proficiency in Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or one language of your choice.
Advantage on saves to stay mounted, mounting costs only 5 feet of movement, and you land on your feet from a fall of 10 feet or less.

When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack you can mark it until the end of your next turn. While it is within 5 feet of you, it has disadvantage on attack rolls that don't target you, and if it deals damage to anyone but you, on your next turn you can make a bonus-action melee weapon attack against it with advantage that deals extra damage equal to half your fighter level on a hit; that attack a number of times equal to your Strength modifier (minimum once) per long rest.

When you or a creature you can see within 5 feet is hit, a reaction adds 1d8 to the target's AC against that attack while you wield a melee weapon or a shield, and the target resists its damage if it still hits; a Constitution-modifier number of times per long rest.

Creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they move 5 feet or more while within your reach, and a creature you hit with an opportunity attack has its speed reduced to 0 until the end of the current turn.

Once on each of your turns, when you move at least 10 feet in a straight line right before attacking a creature and hit it, it makes a Strength save (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier) or is knocked prone.
You get a reaction opportunity attack on every other creature's turn, not just once per round.
A relentless warrior whose sheer conviction keeps them upright long past the point of sense.
Proficiency in History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or one language of your choice.
A bonus action grants advantage on weapon attacks this turn and 5 temporary hit points, rising to 10 at 10th level and 15 at 15th; three uses per long rest.
Add your Wisdom modifier to Persuasion checks, and gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws (Intelligence or Charisma if you already have it).
When you roll initiative with no Fighting Spirit uses left, you regain one.
Trade advantage on one attack for an extra attack against the same target.

When damage reduces you to 0 hit points, a reaction delays your falling unconscious and gives you an extra turn at once; during it, damage at 0 hit points still causes death save failures, and you fall unconscious when it ends if you are still at 0. Once per long rest.
A fighter haunted by a shard of another timeline, fighting beside a grey echo of themselves.

As a bonus action you manifest a gray echo of yourself in an unoccupied space within 15 feet, lasting until it is destroyed, you dismiss it, you manifest another or you are incapacitated. It has AC 14 + your proficiency bonus, 1 hit point and immunity to all conditions, uses your saving throw bonuses, and is destroyed if it ends your turn more than 30 feet from you. On your turn you can command it to move up to 30 feet without an action, swap places with it as a bonus action for 15 feet of your movement, and make any attack of the Attack action from its space; when a creature you can see within 5 feet of it moves at least 5 feet away from it, a reaction makes an opportunity attack as if you stood there.
Make one extra melee attack from your echo's space when you take the Attack action, a Constitution-modifier number of times per long rest.
Project your senses into the echo and send it up to 1,000 feet away for 10 minutes.
A reaction makes your echo take an attack aimed at another creature; once per short or long rest.
When your echo is destroyed by damage, gain temporary hit points of 2d6 + your Constitution modifier, a Constitution-modifier number of times per long rest.
Regain a use of Unleash Incarnation on initiative, and manifest two echoes at once.
A soldier whose mind is the weapon: telekinetic shoves, force shields and psionic strikes.

You have Psionic Energy dice equal to twice your proficiency bonus (d6s, d8s from 5th level, d10s from 11th, d12s from 17th), all regained on a long rest; as a bonus action you can regain one spent die, once per short or long rest.
A reaction spends a die to reduce damage to you or an ally within 30 feet by the die plus your Intelligence modifier.
Once per turn, spend a die to add it plus your Intelligence modifier as force damage to a hit.
Move a Large or smaller object or willing creature 30 feet with your mind, free once per short rest or by spending a die.
Psi-Powered Leap lets you fly briefly as a bonus action, and Telekinetic Thrust can knock a Psionic Strike target prone or push it 10 feet.
Resistance to psychic damage, and a reaction-free end to being charmed or frightened by spending a die.
A bonus action gives yourself and up to your Intelligence modifier in allies half cover for a minute; once per long rest or by spending a die.
Cast telekinesis for free once per long rest, and make one weapon attack as a bonus action while concentrating on it.
A warrior taught giant runecraft, carving power into gear and growing to giant size at need.
Smith's tools and the Giant language.

Inscribe runes on your gear, two at 3rd level and more at 7th, 10th and 15th: Cloud, Fire, Frost, Stone, Hill and Storm, each with a passive benefit and an invokable effect once per short or long rest.
A bonus action for a minute makes you Large, gives advantage on Strength checks and saves, and adds 1d6 to one damage roll per turn; a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
A reaction forces an attacker to reroll a hit against an ally within 60 feet, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
You grow 3d4 inches permanently and Giant's Might's bonus damage becomes 1d8.
Invoke each rune twice per short or long rest.
Giant's Might deals 1d10 and can make you Huge with 5 extra feet of reach.
A knight-commander whose presence steadies a whole unit and spreads their own resilience around.
Second Wind also heals up to three allies within 60 feet for your fighter level.

You gain proficiency in Persuasion, or if you already have it, in your choice of Animal Handling, Insight, Intimidation or Performance; and your proficiency bonus is doubled for any Persuasion check you make.
Action Surge also lets an ally within 60 feet use a reaction to make one weapon attack, two allies from 18th level.

When you use Indomitable to reroll an Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma saving throw and aren't incapacitated, you can choose one ally within 60 feet that also failed its save against the same effect; if it can see or hear you, it rerolls the save and must use the new roll.
A ninja-monk who bends darkness, steps between shadows and strikes from nowhere.
Spend 2 ki to cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace or silence, and you know minor illusion.
A bonus action teleports 60 feet between two patches of dim light or darkness, granting advantage on your next melee attack this turn.
Become invisible in dim light or darkness until you attack, cast, or step into light.
A reaction makes a melee attack against a creature within 5 feet that another creature just hit.
A monk who shapes ki into raw elemental magic: fists of fire, gusts of wind, walls of stone.
Learn elemental disciplines cast by spending ki, starting with Elemental Attunement and one other, and gaining more at 6th, 11th and 17th level; spell save DC and attacks use your ki save DC.
One additional elemental discipline of a level your ki can pay for.
One additional elemental discipline, up to the most powerful ones.
A monk who fights like a stumbling drunk and is never where the blow lands.
Flurry of Blows also grants the benefit of Disengage and 10 feet of extra movement.
Leap to your feet from prone at the cost of 5 feet of movement, and spend 1 ki as a reaction to redirect a miss against you into another creature within 5 feet.
Spend 2 ki to cancel disadvantage on an attack, check or save.
Flurry of Blows grants up to three extra attacks, provided each one hits a different creature.
A weapon-saint who treats a chosen blade or bow as an extension of their unarmed art.

Choose two kensei weapons, one melee and one ranged, from simple or martial weapons without the heavy or special property (the longbow allowed), and one more at 6th, 11th and 17th level; they count as monk weapons, and you are proficient with them and with calligrapher's or painter's supplies. Agile Parry: when you make an unarmed strike as part of the Attack action while holding a kensei melee weapon, you gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn.
A bonus action adds 1d4 damage to ranged kensei attacks this turn.
Kensei weapons count as magical, and 1 ki adds your martial arts die to a hit's damage once per turn.
Spend up to 3 ki as a bonus action for a matching bonus to attack and damage with a kensei weapon for a minute.
Reroll a missed monk-weapon attack once per turn.
A monk who burns ki as radiant light, striking at range and flaring like a small sun.
A ranged spell attack for your martial arts die plus Dexterity in radiant damage at 30 feet, usable with the Attack action and extendable with ki as a bonus action.
After the Attack action, spend 2 ki or more as a bonus action to cast burning hands at a matching level.
A 20-foot sphere within 150 feet deals 2d6 radiant on a failed Constitution save, up to 2d6 more per ki point spent.
Shed 30 feet of bright light at will and deal 5 + Wisdom radiant damage to anyone who hits you in melee.
A monk who studies dying itself, drawing strength from every death nearby.
When you reduce a creature within 5 feet of you to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Wisdom modifier + your monk level (minimum 1).
An action frightens every creature within 30 feet that fails a Wisdom save until the end of your next turn.
Spend 1 ki to stay at 1 hit point instead of dropping to 0, as long as ki remains.
Spend up to 10 ki to deal 2d10 necrotic per point to a creature within 5 feet, halved on a Constitution save.
A masked healer-assassin whose hands can close a wound or stop a heart with the same touch.
Proficiency in Insight and Medicine and with a herbalism kit, plus a mask you are known by.
Spend 1 ki as an action to heal a creature within 5 feet for your martial arts die plus your Wisdom modifier, or replace one Flurry of Blows attack with it.
Once per turn, spend 1 ki on an unarmed hit for extra necrotic damage of your martial arts die plus your Wisdom modifier.
Hand of Healing also ends one condition; Hand of Harm can poison the target until the end of your next turn.
Flurry of Blows can heal without ki cost, and one of its attacks can carry Hand of Harm free.
Once per long rest, spend 5 ki to return a creature dead no more than 24 hours to life with 4d10 + Wisdom hit points.
A monk who summons their own spirit outward as glowing arms, a watching visage and a full body.

As a bonus action, spend 1 ki to summon spectral arms for 10 minutes; when they appear, each creature of your choice you can see within 10 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes force damage equal to two rolls of your martial arts die. While they last you can use Wisdom for Strength checks and saves, your unarmed strikes reach 5 feet farther, and those strikes can use Wisdom for attack and damage rolls and deal force damage.

As a bonus action, spend 1 ki to summon a spectral visage for 10 minutes: Astral Sight (you see normally in darkness, magical or not, to 120 feet), Wisdom of the Spirit (advantage on Insight and Intimidation checks) and Word of the Spirit (you speak to only one creature within 60 feet, or project your voice up to 600 feet).

While both your arms and visage are summoned: Deflect Energy (a reaction reduces acid, cold, fire, force, lightning or thunder damage you take by 1d10 + your Wisdom modifier) and Empowered Arms (once on each of your turns, when you hit with the arms, add one roll of your martial arts die to the damage).
Spend 5 ki for the complete astral body: +2 AC and an extra Arms attack when taking the Attack action.
A monk who studies dragons until their ki breathes, roars and flies like one.

Draconic Presence: when you fail a Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check, a reaction rerolls it, and once this turns a failure into a success you can't do so again until a long rest. Draconic Strike: your unarmed strikes can deal acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison damage instead of bludgeoning. Tongue of Dragons: you learn Draconic, or another language if you know it.

When you take the Attack action you can replace one attack with a 20-foot cone or a 30-foot line 5 feet wide of acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison: each creature in it makes a Dexterity save against your ki save DC or takes two rolls of your martial arts die (three from 11th level), half on a success. A proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest; with none left, 2 ki buys another use.
When you use Step of the Wind, spectral wings give you a flying speed equal to your walking speed until the end of the turn; a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
A bonus action creates a 10-foot aura for a minute that either frightens enemies or grants allies resistance to your damage type; once per long rest or for 3 ki.

Augment Breath: spending 1 ki when you use Breath of the Dragon makes it a 60-foot cone or a 90-foot line 5 feet wide that deals four rolls of your martial arts die. Blindsight: you can perceive your surroundings without sight to 10 feet. Explosive Fury: when you activate Aspect of the Wyrm, each creature of your choice in its aura makes a Dexterity save against your ki save DC or takes 3d10 damage of a type you choose for Draconic Strike.
A paladin sworn to light and life rather than law, shielding what is good from despair.
Spectral vines restrain a creature within 10 feet that fails a Strength or Dexterity save.
Fey and fiends within 30 feet that fail a Wisdom save are turned for a minute, and their disguises drop.
You and allies within 10 feet have resistance to damage from spells, growing to 30 feet at 18th level.
Once per long rest, drop to 1 hit point instead of 0, and you no longer age or weaken with time.
For a minute: regain 10 hit points each turn, cast paladin spells as a bonus action, and enemies within 10 feet have disadvantage on saves against your spells and Channel Divinity.
A paladin who has chosen one wrong to punish and will spend everything to reach it.
One creature within 60 feet is frightened and its speed drops to 0 for a minute on a failed Wisdom save, half that on a success.
A bonus action grants advantage on attacks against one creature within 10 feet for a minute.
An opportunity-attack hit lets you move up to half your speed as part of the reaction, without provoking.
A reaction makes a melee attack against a creature under your Vow of Enmity when it attacks.

As an action you sprout wings for an hour (once per long rest): a flying speed of 60 feet and a 30-foot aura of menace. The first time an enemy enters the aura or starts its turn there during a battle, it makes a Wisdom save or is frightened of you for a minute or until it takes damage, and attack rolls against a creature frightened this way have advantage.
A paladin who believes order is imposed, and rules the battlefield through fear.
Every creature within 30 feet that fails a Wisdom save is frightened for a minute, saving again each turn.
Add +10 to one attack roll after seeing the result.
Frightened creatures within 10 feet have their speed reduced to 0 and take psychic damage equal to half your paladin level each turn; 30 feet at 18th level.
A creature that hits you takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.
For a minute: resistance to all damage, an extra attack with the Attack action, and melee critical hits on a 19 or 20.
A paladin who fights only when talking fails, and takes the blows meant for others.
A +5 bonus to Persuasion checks for 10 minutes.
A reaction deals the same damage back to an attacker who wounded someone near you, halved on a Wisdom save.
A reaction takes the damage aimed at an ally within 10 feet onto yourself, ignoring resistance; 30 feet at 18th level.
Regain 1d6 + half your paladin level hit points at the end of your turn in combat when below half your maximum.

You have resistance to all damage dealt by other creatures, and a creature that hits you with an attack takes radiant damage equal to half the damage you take from it. If you attack a creature, cast a spell on it or damage it other than through this feature, neither benefit works against that creature until you finish a long rest.
A paladin who chases the heroic deed itself, and drags the whole party up to that standard.
For 10 minutes, advantage on Athletics and Acrobatics, extra carrying capacity, and 10 extra feet of jump distance.
After a Divine Smite, hand out temporary hit points of 2d8 + paladin level split among creatures within 30 feet.
Your speed rises by 10 feet, and allies within 5 feet gain 10 feet of speed until their next turn; 10 feet of aura at 18th level.
A reaction adds your Charisma modifier to the AC of yourself or an ally within 10 feet, and a resulting miss lets you attack the attacker; a Charisma-modifier number of times per long rest.

As a bonus action, for a minute you have advantage on Charisma checks, once on each of your turns a weapon attack that misses can hit instead, and when you fail a saving throw a reaction rerolls it and you must use the new roll. Once per long rest, or by expending a 5th-level spell slot.
A paladin trained to detect and destroy extraplanar intruders before they take root.
You and up to your Charisma modifier in allies gain advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saves for a minute.
Aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends within 30 feet that fail a Wisdom save are turned for a minute.
You and allies within 10 feet add your proficiency bonus to initiative; 30 feet at 18th level.

Whenever you or a creature you can see within 30 feet succeeds on an Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma saving throw, a reaction deals 2d8 + your Charisma modifier force damage to the creature that forced the save.
For a minute: truesight to 120 feet, advantage on attacks against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends, and a hit can banish one to its home plane on a failed Charisma save.
A paladin sworn to a realm and its law, holding the line so others can fall back.
Creatures of your choice within 30 feet that fail a Wisdom save cannot move more than 30 feet away from you.
Creatures of your choice within 30 feet below half hit points regain 1d6 + your Charisma modifier hit points.
A reaction takes the damage aimed at a creature within 5 feet onto yourself, ignoring resistance.
Advantage on saving throws against being paralyzed or stunned.
For an hour: resistance to nonmagical weapon damage, advantage on Wisdom saves for you and allies within 30 feet, and death saves at advantage for the same.
A paladin who broke their oath for darker power and now commands the undead. Usually a villain.

As an action, spend Channel Divinity: one undead you can see within 30 feet makes a Wisdom save or obeys your commands for 24 hours or until you use this again. An undead whose challenge rating is equal to or greater than your paladin level is immune.
Creatures of your choice within 30 feet that fail a Wisdom save are frightened for a minute.
You, fiends and undead within 10 feet add your Charisma modifier (at least +1) to melee weapon damage; 30 feet at 18th level.
Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

As an action, for a minute (once per long rest), you wrap yourself in a 30-foot aura of gloom that turns bright light in it dim. Each enemy frightened of you that starts its turn in the aura takes 4d10 psychic damage, creatures that rely on sight have disadvantage on attack rolls against you, and as a bonus action you can make a melee spell attack with the shadows against a creature in the aura, dealing 3d10 + your Charisma modifier necrotic damage.
A ranger who fights alongside a bonded animal companion that acts on their command.

Choose a beast no larger than Medium with a challenge rating of 1/4 or lower as your companion. Add your proficiency bonus to its AC, attack and damage rolls, and the saves and skills it is proficient in; its hit point maximum is its normal maximum or four times your ranger level, whichever is higher. It acts on your initiative: you command its movement freely, and your action commands it to Attack, Dash, Disengage or Help; without a command it takes the Dodge action.
On a turn your companion doesn't attack, a bonus action can command it to Dash, Disengage or Help, and its attacks are magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.
Your companion makes two attacks when you command it to attack.
A spell you cast on yourself also affects your companion within 30 feet.
A ranger of the lightless places who is deadliest in the first seconds of a fight.
+ your Wisdom modifier to initiative, and on your first turn 10 extra feet of speed plus one extra attack dealing an extra 1d8.
Darkvision 60 feet, or 30 more if you had it, and you are invisible to creatures relying on darkvision to see you in darkness.
Proficiency in Wisdom saves, or Intelligence or Charisma if you already have it.
Once per turn, a missed attack lets you make another one.
Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you without advantage, you can use your reaction to give it disadvantage, deciding before you know whether it hits.
A ranger who patrols the seams between planes and steps through them mid-fight.
Sense a planar portal within a mile once per short or long rest.
A bonus action marks a target so your next hit this turn deals its weapon damage plus 1d8 force as force damage; 2d8 from 11th level.
Cast etherealness as a bonus action for one turn, once per short or long rest.
Teleport 10 feet before each attack, and attack a third creature if you struck two others this turn.
A reaction halves the damage of an attack that hits you.
A ranger trained on the things that hunt people: their tricks, their saves, their weaknesses.
An action reveals a creature's damage immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities, a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.
A bonus action marks a creature so your first hit against it each turn deals an extra 1d6.
Add 1d6 to saves and escape checks against effects from your Slayer's Prey target.
A reaction forces a caster or teleporter within 60 feet to make a Wisdom save or lose the spell; once per short or long rest.
A reaction attacks your prey when it forces a save on you, and a hit means the save automatically succeeds.
A ranger carrying a piece of the Feywild: a strange mien, cutting words and psychic strikes.
Once per turn, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d4 psychic damage, rising to 1d6 at 11th level.
Add your Wisdom modifier to Charisma checks, and gain proficiency in Deception, Performance or Persuasion.
Charm person and other fey spells are always prepared and do not count against your spells known.
Advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened, and a reaction redirects a nearby charm or fear onto another creature.

You learn summon fey, which doesn't count against your spells known and needs no material component; you can cast it once without a spell slot per long rest, and whenever you start casting it you can make it need no concentration, in which case it lasts a minute.
Cast misty step without a slot a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest, bringing a willing creature within 5 feet along.
A ranger accompanied by a bound swarm of tiny nature spirits that bite, shove and carry.
Once per turn, a hit lets your swarm deal 1d6 piercing damage, move the target 15 feet, or move you 5 feet without provoking; 1d8 from 11th level.
Mage hand and a short list of swarm spells are always prepared and do not count against your spells known.
A bonus action grants a 10-foot flying speed for a minute, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.

Gathered Swarm's damage becomes 1d8, a creature that fails its save against being moved by the swarm can also be knocked prone, and when the swarm moves you, you have half cover until the start of your next turn.
A reaction gives resistance to damage taken and teleports you 30 feet, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
A ranger bonded to a young draconic spirit that grows from a helper into a mount.
You know thaumaturgy and learn Draconic, or another language if you already speak it.

As an action, summon your drake in an unoccupied space within 30 feet, lasting until it drops to 0 hit points, you summon it again or you die; once per long rest, or by expending a spell slot of 1st level or higher. Choose its Draconic Essence when you summon it (acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison): it is immune to that damage. It has 5 + five times your ranger level hit points, a Bite (1d6 + your proficiency bonus piercing) and an Infused Strikes reaction (when another creature within 30 feet of it that it can see hits with a weapon attack, that attack deals an extra 1d6 damage of its essence type). It acts on your initiative and takes the Dodge action unless you command it with a bonus action.

Your drake grows to Medium, grows wings (a flying speed equal to its walking speed) and can carry you as a mount; its Bite deals an extra 1d6 damage of its essence type, and you have resistance to that damage type.

As an action, you or your drake exhales a 30-foot cone of acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison (your choice): each creature in it makes a Dexterity save against your spell save DC or takes 8d6 damage (10d6 from 15th level), half on a success. Once per long rest, or by expending a spell slot of 3rd level or higher.

Your drake grows to Large and its Bite's extra damage becomes 2d6. Reflexive Resistance: when you or your drake takes damage while you are within 30 feet of each other, a reaction gives the one hurt resistance to that damage, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
A killer who opens fights already having won them, and wears other people's faces to get close.
Proficiency with the disguise kit and the poisoner's kit.
Advantage on attacks against any creature that has not taken a turn yet, and any hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.
Spend 25 gp and seven days to build a false identity you can adopt convincingly.
After studying someone for three hours, mimic their speech, writing and behaviour well enough to fool most observers.
When you hit a surprised creature, it makes a Constitution save against 8 + Dexterity + proficiency or takes double damage.
A thief who studied just enough wizardry to make locks, pockets and minds easier work.
Third-caster wizard spellcasting keyed to Intelligence, drawn mostly from enchantment and illusion.
Your mage hand is invisible, and can pick locks, disarm traps, stow items and pick pockets at your Sleight of Hand bonus.
A creature you are hidden from has disadvantage on saves against your spell that turn.
A bonus action uses mage hand to distract a creature, giving you advantage on attacks against it that turn.

Right after a creature casts a spell that targets you or includes you in its area, a reaction makes it save with its spellcasting ability modifier against your spell save DC. On a failure the spell has no effect on you, and if it is of 1st level or higher and of a level you can cast, you steal it: for 8 hours you know it and can cast it with your spell slots, and the creature can't cast it. Once per long rest.
A schemer who reads people, plants words and directs the fight from behind an ally's shoulder.
Proficiency with the disguise kit, forgery kit and one gaming set, two extra languages, and the ability to mimic a heard speech pattern and accent.
Use the Help action as a bonus action at up to 30 feet.
A minute of observation reveals whether a creature is your better or worse in Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma and class levels.
A reaction redirects an attack aimed at you onto a creature within 5 feet that is giving you cover.
Your thoughts cannot be read, magic always reads you as truthful, and you choose what a mind-reader finds.
A duellist who fights in the open, one on one, and talks the whole time.
A creature you attack in melee cannot make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.
Add your Charisma modifier to initiative, and sneak attack works whenever you are within 5 feet of your target alone, with no need for advantage.
A Persuasion check against a creature's Insight either charms it into following you peacefully or fixes its attention on you in a fight for a minute.
A bonus action grants advantage on your next Acrobatics or Athletics check.
Once per short or long rest, reroll a missed attack with advantage.
A detective-rogue who finds the tell, the lie and the weak point, then puts a blade in it.
When you make a Wisdom (Insight) check to tell whether a creature is lying, treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.
A bonus action makes a Perception check for hidden things or an Investigation check for clues.
A bonus-action Insight check against a creature's Deception lets you sneak attack it for a minute without needing advantage or an ally.
Advantage on Perception and Investigation checks after moving no more than half your speed on your turn.
Sense illusions, shapechangers and other deceptions within 30 feet, a Wisdom-modifier number of times per long rest.
Sneak attack against your Insightful Fighting target deals an extra 3d6.
A skirmisher and pathfinder who slips out of reach the moment anyone closes.
A reaction moves you half your speed when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet, without provoking.
Proficiency and expertise in Nature and Survival.
Your walking speed rises by 10 feet, along with any climb or swim speed you have.
Advantage on initiative, and the first creature you hit on your first turn gives your allies advantage against it until your next turn.
A bonus action makes an extra attack, and you can sneak attack twice per turn as long as it is against different targets.
A rogue standing half in the land of the dead, collecting skills and souls as they go.
After each rest, gain proficiency in one skill or tool of your choice.
After a sneak attack drops or wounds a creature, a second creature within 30 feet takes half your sneak attack dice in necrotic damage; a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.

When a creature you can see dies within 30 feet of you, a reaction forms a Tiny soul trinket in your free hand (you can hold up to your proficiency bonus of them). While you carry one you have advantage on death saving throws and Constitution saving throws. When you deal Sneak Attack damage you can destroy one to use Wails from the Grave without spending a use, and as an action you can destroy one to ask its spirit a question.
A bonus action makes you spectral for 10 minutes with a 10-foot fly speed and the ability to move through creatures and objects; free once per long rest, otherwise costs a soul trinket.
When you use Wails from the Grave, you can deal its necrotic damage to the first creature as well as the second, and at the end of a long rest a soul trinket appears in your hand if you have none.
A rogue whose weapons are made of thought, thrown and re-formed at will.

You have Psionic Energy dice equal to twice your proficiency bonus (d6s, d8s from 5th level, d10s from 11th, d12s from 17th), all regained on a long rest; as a bonus action you can regain one spent die, once per short or long rest.
Spend a die to turn a failed check with a proficient skill or tool into a success if the die closes the gap.
Establish telepathic communication with creatures you can see for hours, free once per long rest and otherwise for a die.

When you take the Attack action you can manifest a psychic blade in a free hand and attack with it: a simple melee weapon with finesse and thrown (60/120) that deals 1d6 psychic damage plus your ability modifier and vanishes after the attack. After attacking with it, a bonus action can manifest a second blade in your other hand for 1d4 psychic damage plus your ability modifier. The blades keep these dice at every level.
Homing Strikes adds a die to a missed Psychic Blades attack, and Psychic Teleportation throws a blade to teleport yourself up to 10 times your die roll in feet.
Turn invisible for an hour as an action, free once per long rest and otherwise for a die; it ends if you deal damage or force a save.
A sneak attack with Psychic Blades can stun a creature for a minute on a failed Wisdom save; free once per long rest and otherwise for three dice.
A sorcerer whose power came from somewhere chaotic and has never fully settled down.
After casting a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the GM may have you roll a d20; on a 1 you roll on the wild magic table.
Gain advantage on one attack, check or save; the GM can then trigger a Wild Magic Surge to restore the use.
A reaction spends 2 sorcery points to add or subtract 1d4 on another creature's attack, check or save.
Roll twice on the wild magic table and pick either result.
Once per turn, the highest damage die you roll for a spell explodes: roll it again and add it.
A sorcerer whose bloodline runs back to something divine, mixing cleric magic into raw sorcery.

You can learn cleric spells as sorcerer spells, and you choose an affinity for your divine power that teaches you one more sorcerer spell, which doesn't count against your spells known: cure wounds (good), inflict wounds (evil), bless (law), bane (chaos) or protection from evil and good (neutrality). If you replace that spell later, it must become a cleric spell.
Once per short or long rest, add 2d4 to a failed save or missed attack.
Spend 1 sorcery point to reroll healing dice for yourself or an ally, once per turn.
A bonus action grants a 30-foot flying speed with spectral wings.
Once per long rest, a bonus action when you have fewer than half your hit points left restores hit points equal to half your maximum.
A sorcerer touched by the Shadowfell, hard to kill and accompanied by a hound of ill omen.

You have darkvision out to 120 feet. From 3rd level you know darkness, which doesn't count against your spells known; you can cast it with 2 sorcery points as well as a slot, and when you do you can see through that darkness.

When damage reduces you to 0 hit points, you can make a Charisma save (DC 5 + the damage taken) to drop to 1 hit point instead. It fails against radiant damage or a critical hit, and after a success you can't use it again until a long rest.
Spend 3 sorcery points to summon a shadow dire wolf that chases one creature, gives your spells advantage against it, and blocks its escape.
A bonus action teleports 120 feet between dim or dark spaces.
Spend 6 sorcery points to become shadow for a minute: resistance to all but force and radiant damage, and the ability to move through creatures and objects.
A sorcerer of wind and thunder who drifts through fights on their own weather.
You speak, read and write Primordial and its dialects.
Before or after casting a spell of 1st level or higher, a bonus action lets you fly 10 feet without provoking.
Resistance to lightning and thunder damage, and casting a spell of those types deals half your sorcerer level in damage to creatures within 10 feet.
Stop rain around you or steer the wind's direction as a bonus action.
A reaction deals your sorcerer level in lightning damage to a melee attacker and pushes it 20 feet on a failed Strength save.
Immunity to lightning and thunder damage, a 60-foot flying speed, and the ability to grant allies 30 feet of flight for an hour, once per short or long rest.
A sorcerer whose gift came from something far outside, and speaks in telepathy and warped magic.
A set of psionic spells always known that do not count against your spells known, swappable for divination and enchantment spells as you level.
A bonus action opens a telepathic link with one creature within 30 feet for minutes equal to your sorcerer level.
Cast your psionic spells by spending sorcery points instead of a slot, with no verbal, somatic or costly components.
Resistance to psychic damage and advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.

As a bonus action, spend 1 or more sorcery points to transform for 10 minutes, choosing one benefit per point: you see any invisible creature within 60 feet that isn't behind total cover; you gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can hover; you gain a swimming speed of twice your walking speed and breathe water; or you can squeeze through a space as narrow as an inch and spend 5 feet of movement to escape nonmagical restraints or a grapple.

As an action, teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space you can see; each creature within 30 feet of the space you left makes a Strength save against your spell save DC, taking 3d10 force damage and being pulled toward that space on a failure, or half damage on a success. Once per long rest, or by spending 5 sorcery points.
A sorcerer aligned to the machinery of absolute order, smoothing chaos out of the world.
A set of order-themed spells always known that do not count against your spells known, swappable for abjuration and transmutation spells as you level.
A reaction cancels advantage or disadvantage on a roll within 60 feet, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
Spend 1 to 5 sorcery points to give a creature that many d8s to spend reducing damage, until your next long rest.
For a minute, attacks against you cannot have advantage and you treat any d20 of 9 or lower as a 10 on attacks, checks and saves; once per long rest or for 5 sorcery points.
A 30-foot cube heals 100 hit points among creatures in it, ends spells of 6th level or lower, and repairs damaged objects; once per long rest or for 7 sorcery points.
A sorcerer whose magic waxes and wanes with a moon phase they can choose at will.

You learn the spells of all three moon phases, one of each phase at sorcerer levels 1, 3, 5, 7 and 9, and they don't count against your spells known: Full Moon (shield, lesser restoration, dispel magic, death ward, Rary's telepathic bond), New Moon (ray of sickness, blindness/deafness, vampiric touch, confusion, hold monster) and Crescent Moon (color spray, alter self, phantom steed, hallucinatory terrain, mislead). After each long rest you choose a phase; until your next long rest you can cast its 1st-level spell once without a spell slot.
You learn sacred flame, which doesn't count against your cantrips known; when you cast it you can target one creature or two creatures within 5 feet of each other.

When you use Metamagic on a spell of your current phase's schools (Full Moon: abjuration and divination; New Moon: enchantment and necromancy; Crescent Moon: illusion and transmutation), it costs 1 sorcery point less (minimum 0), a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.
As a bonus action you can spend 1 sorcery point to change your current phase, and you can cast the 1st-level spell of each phase once without a spell slot, regaining those castings on a long rest.

Your current phase empowers you. Full Moon: a bonus action sheds bright light in 10 feet and dim light 10 feet beyond (or douses it), and you and creatures of your choice in that bright light have advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) and Wisdom (Perception) checks. New Moon: advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and attack rolls against you have disadvantage while you are entirely in darkness. Crescent Moon: you resist necrotic and radiant damage.

As a bonus action, once per long rest or for 5 sorcery points, you release your phase's power. Full Moon: each creature of your choice within 30 feet makes a Constitution save or is blinded until the end of its next turn, and one creature of your choice there regains 3d8 hit points. New Moon: each creature of your choice within 30 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes 3d10 necrotic damage and has speed 0 until the end of its next turn, and you are invisible until the end of your next turn or until you attack or cast a spell. Crescent Moon: you teleport up to 60 feet with one willing creature within 5 feet of you, and each of you resists all damage until the start of your next turn.
A pact with a lord or lady of the Feywild: charm, illusion and very sharp bargains.
An action charms or frightens every creature in a 10-foot cube that fails a Wisdom save until the end of your next turn; recharges on a short or long rest.
A reaction on taking damage turns you invisible and teleports you 60 feet; recharges on a short or long rest.
You can't be charmed, and when another creature tries to charm you, a reaction makes it save on Wisdom against your spell save DC or be charmed by you for a minute or until it takes damage.

As an action, a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or is charmed or frightened by you (your choice) for a minute or until your concentration breaks or it takes damage; it believes it is lost in a misty realm and can see and hear only itself, you and the illusion. Once per short or long rest.
A pact with something vast and probably unaware of you, paid in telepathy and madness.
You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 30 feet; it must understand at least one language, but it needn't share one with you.
A reaction imposes disadvantage on an attack against you, and a miss grants advantage on your next attack against that creature; recharges on a short or long rest.
Your thoughts cannot be read, you resist psychic damage, and psychic damage dealt to you is dealt back to the attacker.
An incapacitated humanoid you touch becomes charmed until a remove curse, with telepathic contact at any distance on the same plane.
A pact with a being of the Upper Planes: radiant fire in one hand, healing light in the other.
You know light and sacred flame.

A pool of d6s equal to 1 + your warlock level, refilled on a long rest. As a bonus action, spend up to your Charisma modifier (minimum one) of them to heal a creature you can see within 60 feet by the total rolled.
You have resistance to radiant damage. When you cast a spell that deals radiant or fire damage, add your Charisma modifier to one radiant or fire damage roll of that spell against one of its targets.

Whenever you finish a short or long rest, you gain temporary hit points equal to your warlock level + your Charisma modifier, and up to five creatures of your choice you can see each gain half your warlock level + your Charisma modifier.
When you would make a death save, rise instead at half hit points, blinding and burning enemies within 30 feet for 2d8 + Charisma radiant damage; recharges on a long rest.
A pact with a sentient weapon from the Shadowfell: a warlock who fights in armor, with a blade.

As a bonus action, curse a creature you can see within 30 feet for a minute, or until it or you die or you are incapacitated: you add your proficiency bonus to damage rolls against it, your attack rolls against it score a critical hit on a 19 or 20, and when it dies you regain hit points equal to your warlock level + your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Once per short or long rest.

You gain proficiency with medium armor, shields and martial weapons. At the end of a long rest you can touch a weapon you are proficient with that lacks the two-handed property: you use Charisma instead of Strength or Dexterity for its attack and damage rolls until you use this again. With Pact of the Blade, this also holds for every pact weapon you conjure.

When you slay a humanoid, its spirit rises as a specter under your command in an unoccupied space near the corpse: it has temporary hit points equal to half your warlock level, adds your Charisma modifier (minimum +0) to its attack rolls, and leaves at the end of your next long rest. Once per long rest.
When the target of your Hexblade's Curse hits you with an attack roll, a reaction rolls a d6: on a 4 or higher the attack misses, whatever its roll.

When the creature cursed by your Hexblade's Curse dies, you can move the curse to another creature you can see within 30 feet of it, if you aren't incapacitated; you don't regain hit points from the first creature's death when you do.
A pact with something in the deep water, which sends a tentacle when called.

As a bonus action, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest, create a 10-foot spectral tentacle at a point you can see within 60 feet for a minute. When it appears, and as a bonus action on later turns, it can strike a creature within 10 feet of it with a melee spell attack for 1d8 cold damage (2d8 from 10th level), and the target's speed drops by 10 feet until the start of your next turn; you can move it up to 30 feet when you make that attack.
A 40-foot swimming speed and the ability to breathe underwater.
You resist cold damage, and while you are fully submerged, any creature also fully submerged can understand your speech and you can understand its.
Your tentacle reduces damage to you or a creature near it by 1d8, rising to 2d8 at 10th level.

You learn Evard's black tentacles, a warlock spell for you that doesn't count against your spells known, and can cast it once per long rest without a spell slot. Casting it gives you temporary hit points equal to your warlock level, and damage can't break your concentration on it.
Teleport yourself and up to five willing creatures to a body of water within a mile; recharges on a short or long rest.
A pact with a noble genie, carrying their element and a vessel you can climb inside.

Your patron's kind (Dao, Djinni, Efreeti or Marid) sets your Genie's Wrath damage type and part of your expanded spells. Your vessel is a Tiny object (AC equal to your spell save DC, hit points equal to your warlock level + your proficiency bonus) and your spellcasting focus. Bottled Respite: as an action, vanish into it for up to twice your proficiency bonus in hours, leaving early as a bonus action; once per long rest. Genie's Wrath: once on each of your turns, a hit with an attack roll deals extra damage of your patron's type equal to your proficiency bonus (bludgeoning for a dao, thunder for a djinni, fire for an efreeti, cold for a marid).
You have resistance to your patron's damage type, and as a bonus action you gain a 30-foot flying speed (hovering) for 10 minutes, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest.

When you enter your vessel through Bottled Respite, up to five willing creatures within 30 feet can come in with you. Anyone who stays inside at least 10 minutes gains the benefit of a short rest, and anyone who spends Hit Dice in it adds your proficiency bonus to the hit points each die restores.

As an action, you produce the effect of one spell of 6th level or lower, from any class's list, with a casting time of one action, ignoring its requirements and costly components. You can use it again only after 1d4 long rests.
A pact with a lich or worse: the warlock becomes a little more like their patron each level.
